tools.name: skyprep_list_users
tools.description: List learners, managers and admins in the SkyPrep account, with optional filters. Paged with `page`. API: get_users.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user
tools.description: Get one user's profile by user_id or user_email. API: get_user.

tools.name: skyprep_list_courses
tools.description: List the courses in the SkyPrep account, with their codes, categories and course ids. API: get_courses.

tools.name: skyprep_get_course
tools.description: Get one course by course_id, including its items and catalog settings. API: get_course.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user_courses
tools.description: List the courses one user is enrolled in, by user_email. API: get_user_courses.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user_course_status
tools.description: Get one user's status in one course: passed, failed, not-started, in-progress or archived. API: get_user_course_status.

tools.name: skyprep_list_user_groups
tools.description: List the user groups (departments, teams, cohorts) in the SkyPrep account. API: get_user_groups.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user_group
tools.description: Get one user group by user_group_id, with its members. API: get_user_group.

tools.name: skyprep_list_learning_paths
tools.description: List the learning paths in the SkyPrep account. API: get_learning_paths.

tools.name: skyprep_get_course_progresses
tools.description: Get course progress records, filtered by course, user and status. Status is passed, failed, not-started, in-progress, not-applicable or archived. API: get_course_progresses.

tools.name: skyprep_create_user
tools.description: Create a learner, content manager or manager. Admin accounts cannot be created here. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: create_user.

tools.name: skyprep_update_user
tools.description: Update a user's name, title, identifier or phone numbers. Only the fields you pass change. Roles, admin and manager flags, and access dates cannot be changed here. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: update_user.

tools.name: skyprep_enroll_user_in_course
tools.description: Enroll one user in one course, by user_id or user_email, with an optional enrollment expiry date. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: enroll_user_in_course.

tools.name: skyprep_enroll_user_in_user_group
tools.description: Add one user to one user group, with an optional membership expiry date. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: enroll_user_in_user_group.
